purpose: Verify that every claim in evaluation-specification.md is tagged with exactly one evidence type and is not double-classified (theorem posing as hypothesis; invariant posing as behavioural outcome; census posing as population estimate).

checks.check: P1..P4 are tagged FORMAL and require no dataset, no ± spread, no significance test
checks.evidence: evaluation-specification.csv rows carry evidence_type=FORMAL or 'FORMAL (proposition)'; reporting_boundary explicitly excludes ± and significance testing.

checks.check: F1..F3 are tagged IMPLEMENTATION-FIDELITY and are not described as re-proofs of Safety Dominance or as behavioural hypotheses
checks.evidence: reporting_boundary states 'Test of specification conformance — does not empirically rediscover Theorem 6.3'. Section 7 of evaluation-specification.md restates this explicitly.

checks.check: E1..E4, E6 are tagged EMPIRICAL-TRACE and reported as exact descriptive census values, not as estimates
checks.evidence: reporting_boundary carries 'Exact descriptive values for the analysed trace / configuration — not estimates of future Sabah conditions; no p-values, no CIs' or equivalent.

checks.check: E5 / RQ-J2 is the only row that admits inferential statistical treatment (timing carries variance)
checks.evidence: evaluation-specification.md §11 states inferential treatment is legitimate here; §12 preserves the census framing for all other empirical rows.

checks.check: No row silently mixes evidence types
checks.evidence: rq-audit.csv and hypothesis-audit.csv record the reclassifications that untangled the earlier mixed cases (H1/H2 fidelity, H3 performance, H4 empirical-trace, RQ-J3 empirical-trace).

checks.check: H1 and H2 are no longer circular behavioural hypotheses
checks.evidence: hypothesis-audit.csv records H1→F1 and H2→F2 reclassification with rationale citing Theorem 6.3 predetermination. evaluation-specification.md §7 documents the change.

checks.check: H3 acceptance threshold is not fabricated
checks.evidence: evaluation-specification.md §11 states H3 = X ms is OPEN; §17 lists it as OPEN-1; no numerical value invented.

checks.check: H4 restated as an uncertain/dataset-dependent quantity (Δ_L2) rather than a definition
checks.evidence: evaluation-specification.md §10 and §18 present Δ_L2 as the load-bearing empirical result; hypothesis-audit.csv row H4 documents the reformulation.

checks.check: Decision-support utility metric is resolved OR explicitly OPEN
checks.evidence: metric-audit.csv marks utility 'OPEN — CONSTRUCT DEFINITION REQUIRED'; evaluation-specification.md §9 and §17 (OPEN-2) preserve this; no utility formula invented.
